title: OpenAI's pre-release GPT-6.2 Astra was easier to jailbreak than its predecessor, UK government testers found
title_zh: 英国政府测试人员发现，OpenAI 预发布的 GPT-6.2 Astra 比其前代产品更容易被越狱。
